seo.meta_title: Are Cheddar's Honey Butter Croissants Free? What to Know
seo.meta_description: Cheddar's gives every guest a free Honey Butter Croissant each visit at company-owned locations. How it works, where it's not offered and what extras cost.
seo.h1: Are Cheddar's Honey Butter Croissants Free?

question: Are Cheddar's Honey Butter Croissants Free?
quick_answer: Yes, at most locations. Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen gives every guest a free Honey Butter Croissant on every visit. The croissants are baked in-house and drizzled with house-whipped honey butter. The free croissant offer isn't available at Cheddar's locations in Colorado or at franchise locations, and if you want more than your free one, extra orders cost about $2.
key_facts: One free croissant per guest, every visit
Baked in-house and drizzled with honey butter
Not free at Colorado and franchise locations

body.heading: How the free croissants work
body.text: Cheddar's says it welcomes every guest with a free round of its fresh-baked Honey Butter Croissants, one for each person, every visit. Cheddar's lists the croissant as free with every visit, so you don't need a coupon or app.

body.heading: Where they're not free
body.text: Cheddar's notes that the free croissant offer is not available at its Colorado locations or at franchise-owned restaurants. If you're not sure whether your local Cheddar's is company-owned, ask your server.

body.heading: What's in them
body.text: The croissants are soft, flaky pastries baked in-house until golden brown, then drizzled with Cheddar's house-whipped honey butter while warm. Cheddar's has said they're baked fresh throughout the day. The honey butter is what makes them sweet and is the reason many fans ask for extra.

body.heading: How much extra croissants cost
body.text: If one isn't enough, you can order more. On our Cheddar's menu page, an order of Honey Butter Croissants is listed at about $1.99, and other listings show slightly different prices by location. Family bundles also come with croissants.

body.heading: When Cheddar's started giving them away
body.text: Honey Butter Croissants were on Cheddar's menu for years as a paid item. Cheddar's began offering them free to every guest in late 2019 as a way to welcome diners and bring them back. Cheddar's is owned by Darden Restaurants, the parent company of Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse. For other prices, see our Cheddar's menu page.

faqs.a: Yes. Every guest gets one free Honey Butter Croissant per visit at company-owned locations outside Colorado.
No. The free offer is one croissant per guest. You can order more for about $2.

faqs.q: Why aren't croissants free at my Cheddar's?
faqs.a: The free croissant offer isn't available at Colorado locations or franchise-owned restaurants.
Darden Restaurants, which also owns Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse.
